clips.title: "If I'm ever feeling powerless, I remind myself that I am God"
clips.why: A soft closing question gets an answer nobody sees coming: 'I remind myself that I am God. I am all powerful. I create everything in my life.' Said calmly, on the record, with a follow-through about daydreaming that almost justifies it. This is the quiet-part-out-loud clip — screenshots and comment-section arguments guaranteed.

clips.text: So now when you feel powerless again, what's your personal framework to become powerful? >> Well, this one is going to maybe sound even a little bit spiritual. I have a few beliefs. One of my beliefs is that the universe and the world is not how it seems. that a great amount of my reality is a construct of my own mind, which means I can influence the world and my life through what's happening in here. So, I protect this thing. I protect it by not letting bad stuff in. I audit what it's doing and what it's thinking. And if I'm ever feeling powerless, I remind myself that I am God. I am all powerful. I create everything in my life because you can. You truly can. You can create your own reality, your consciousness. Like literally truly my conscious experience. clips.title: "Why do you call it 5 a.m. club porn?"
